about: icons2 samples (Forms / Strikes / Virtues). Medallion icons; labels are drawn by the game.

icon-rooted-form-64.note: Rooted Form = a wide, even, symmetric horse-style stance, front view. Technique: feet about two shoulder-widths apart and parallel, both knees bent equally and pushed out over the toes, hips low and level, back straight and upright, guard up (both fists in front at chin height, elbows down).

icon-follow-up-kick-64.note: Follow-up Kick = Strike adds a second kick. Side view facing right. Technique (front kick): support leg slightly bent with the foot flat, hips forward, kicking leg extended at chest height striking with the ball of the foot (toes pulled back), guard kept up. The first, lower kick is a soft ghost; a curved arrow shows the follow-up rising to the second.

icon-shield-of-respect-64.note: Shield of Respect = a gold shield with a student bowing (rei). Technique (standing bow): heels together, legs straight, bend about 30 degrees at the waist with a straight back, hands flat at the sides of the thighs, eyes down.
